Continuous Glucose Monitors (CGMs)
Function
: Wearable sensors applied to the skin (arm or abdomen) to track interstitial fluid glucose levels in real time.
Leading Brands
: Abbott FreeStyle Libre and Dexcom (e.g., Dexcom G7).
Access
: Generally require a prescription and specific insurance or Medicare qualification criteria.
Centers for Disease Control and Prevention | CDC (.gov)
Smartwatches & Wearable ECG
Function
: Consumer wrist-worn devices that track heart rate, blood oxygen (SpO₂), and record single-lead electrocardiograms (ECGs) to detect irregularities like atrial fibrillation.
Nuance on Glucose
: Smartwatches cannot independently perform non-invasive blood glucose measurements via light sensors alone; any glucose data displayed on a smartwatch is mirrored data streamed via Bluetooth from a separate body-worn CGM sensor.

Sleep Trackers & Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM)
Sleep Trackers
: Consumer bands, rings, or smartwatches that analyze sleep stages, resting heart rate, and temperature variations.
Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM)
: Clinical setups where medical-grade devices (such as cellular-connected blood pressure cuffs, weight scales, or CGMs) automatically transmit physiological data back to a healthcare provider's platform for chronic disease management.
